title: Gully does the pots
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully takes the skiff out alone for the first time to check the winter set. The uncle watches from the shack door. Wood watches the uncle watching. The strip is about the door.

panels.composition: The skiff going out alone, GULLY at the tiller, the bay gray. From the launch.

image.prompt: a small skiff heading out alone across a gray bay with a stocky teenager at the tiller, seen from a boat launch, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The UNCLE in the shack door, one hand on the frame. Watching the skiff.

image.prompt: an old man standing in a bait shack doorway with one hand on the frame watching a distant skiff, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD on a pot with BARNABY, watching the uncle. The pad closed.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on a crab pot with a small dog, watching an old man in a doorway, a drawing pad closed on his knee, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The skiff coming back, a speck. The uncle stepping back inside before it lands. He didn't want to be seen watching. The strip saw.

image.prompt: a skiff returning across a gray bay as a speck while an old man steps back into a shack doorway, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The uncle steps back before the skiff lands. The strip saw.
